verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that Facial Similarity reports compare a live photo, live video or motion capture to the face on the most recent identity document. They also show that Motion assesses liveness through head-turn or randomized head-movement challenges. However, nothing in the pack names defenses against printed photos, screen replays or replayed video, which is a core part of this story. Missing for 10: documented anti-spoofing coverage for print, screen and video-replay attacks, plus accuracy or certification data and independent or hands-on corroboration of liveness performance.
